---
name: "nf-core/hmmer/hmmrank"
description: "Ranks hmmer/hmmsearch hits by score/e-value and, optionally, attaches\
  \ per-hit domain\ncoordinates -- reading the already-parsed, already-typed Parquet\
  \ table(s) hmmer/formattsv\n+ duckdb/table2parquet produce, rather than parsing\
  \ raw hmmsearch tblout/domtblout text\nitself. The ranking and domain-coordinate\
  \ merge run as DuckDB SQL (window functions,\ndisk-spillable temp tables) instead\
  \ of in-memory R/dplyr, so memory use no longer scales\nwith the full width of every\
  \ input row held at once.\n"
keywords:
- "hmmer"
- "hmmsearch"
- "rank"
- "duckdb"
tools:
- hmmer:
    description: "Biosequence analysis using profile hidden Markov models"
    homepage: "http://hmmer.org/"
    documentation: "http://hmmer.org/documentation.html"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/EddyRivasLab/hmmer"
    doi: "10.1371/journal.pcbi.1002195"
    licence:
    - "BSD"
    identifier: ""
- duckdb:
    description: "An in-process SQL OLAP database management system"
    homepage: "https://duckdb.org"
    documentation: "https://duckdb.org/docs/"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:duckdb"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - tblout:
      type: "file"
      description: "A single Parquet table combining every hmmsearch per-sequence\
        \ hit table (--tblout)\nfor this meta, as produced by hmmer/formattsv (format\
        \ 'tblout') followed by\nduckdb/table2parquet -- one profile-labelled row\
        \ per hit, columns already typed.\n"
      pattern: "*.parquet"
      ontologies: []
  - domtblout:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional single Parquet table combining every hmmsearch per-domain\
        \ hit table\n(--domtblout) for this meta, as produced by hmmer/formattsv (format\
        \ 'domtblout')\nfollowed by duckdb/table2parquet. When supplied ([] when not),\
        \ the ranked table\ngains the target and profile lengths and, for each of\
        \ the three coordinate sets,\nthe outer bounds of the match, the size of the\
        \ union of the pair's domains, and\nthe number of separate stretches that\
        \ union spans. Every domain hmmsearch reported\nis counted, whatever its own\
        \ significance: a hit can clear the full-sequence\nthreshold while each of\
        \ its domains is weak in isolation, and dropping those would\nleave exactly\
        \ such hits without coordinates. Domains are grouped by query name as\nwell\
        \ as by profile, so an HMM file holding several models searched in one go\
        \ still\nyields one row per (sequence, model).\n"
      pattern: "*.parquet"
      ontologies: []
output:
  hmmrank:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.hmmrank.tsv.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "TSV file with ranked hmmer results: one row per (accno, profile,\
          \ profile_desc)\ncombination -- profile_desc holds the query name, i.e.\
          \ the model, which one file\nmay hold several of -- with profile, accno,\
          \ profile_desc, evalue, score and rank.\nWhen domtblout is supplied it also\
          \ carries tlen and qlen, plus from, to,\nlen and n_islands for\neach of\
          \ the hmm, ali and env coordinate sets. n_islands is 1 when the domains\n\
          merge into a single continuous stretch and rises as they scatter; coordinates\n\
          are inclusive, so domains that abut with no gap between them count as one.\n\
          All fourteen are NA where a hit has no domain records behind it: hmmsearch\n\
          reports a sequence on the per-sequence threshold, while a domain also has\
          \ to\nclear the per-domain one, so the two tables need not agree on every\
          \ hit.\n"
        pattern: "*.hmmrank.tsv.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
  versions_duckdb:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - duckdb:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - duckdb --version | sed 's/^v//; s/ .*//':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - duckdb:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - duckdb --version | sed 's/^v//; s/ .*//':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
